limits: Historical compact reports and test logs are not fresh application reruns or cryptographic execution attestations.
Application artifacts and screenshot pixels are excluded. Metadata hashes refer to public-template/synthetic-case application runs.
The raw input and native candidate hashes were independently regenerated during source packaging.
Origin lifecycle remains NOT_RUN; native-safe export is unsupported.
